name: comp-32
title: Floating Label Input
description: An email field whose label starts centred inside the box like a placeholder, then shrinks and rises to sit across the top border when focused or filled.
use: Compact forms where a separate label line would add height and the hint should show when empty.
avoid: The label is baked into the file, so reusing the field for another purpose means editing the copy.
a11y: The label is properly bound and the field shows a focus ring, but the move has no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single rounded dark email field on a black stage. At rest its grey label sits centred inside the box; once focused or filled the label turns white, shrinks and rests over the top border with a darker patch behind it.
behaves: Focusing lifts the label from the middle of the field to its top edge while it shrinks and brightens, and it stays there once an address is typed. The clip shows the idle label, the jump, then maya@stashui.dev typed beneath the raised label.
customise: The label text and the email field type are fixed in the file; label colour, size and position are utility classes there.
weight: light: One field and one label moved with a CSS transition; idle otherwise.
